outcome: Cellular transcriptome dynamics in maternal circulation
Expression of immune-related genes (e.g., MMP8, DEFA1B, DEFA4, LTF)
Dynamics of immune cell mRNA signatures (T cells, B cells, erythroid cells)
Modulation of immune and inflammatory pathways
finding: Unique changes in immune-related genes were discovered in the maternal cellular transcriptome throughout normal pregnancy, with positive correlations observed between the cellular transcriptome and plasma proteome for specific genes/proteins.
gest_age: Samples were collected from 10 to 40 weeks of gestation.
